description:
I visited Nilachal, Nilgiri, Chimbuk Hill, and the Shoilopropat in 1 day | Bandarban Tour Part-1

In this video, I’m taking you along on my multi-day trip to Bandarban, one of the most beautiful hill destinations in Bangladesh.

Throughout this series, I’ll share my real Bandarban experience from the breathtaking mountain views and winding roads to the peaceful nature, local culture, and the amazing places I explored along the way. I’ll show you where I stayed, what I visited, and what made this journey truly unforgettable.

📌 What you’ll see in this vlog: 
- Nilachal
- Nilgiri
- Chimbuk Hill
- Shoilopropat  Waterfall
